image.subject: 熊本強震後啟動航空援助 華航集團捐新台幣1,000萬元並免費運送賑災物資

zh.title: 熊本強震後啟動航空援助 華航集團捐新台幣1,000萬元並免費運送賑災物資
zh.summary: 日本熊本縣日前發生規模7.1強震，造成當地建築、道路及交通設施受損，災後救援與重建工作持續進行。中華航空宣布，華航集團將捐出新台幣1,000萬元，支援熊本地區災後救援及重建工作。
body: 日本熊本縣日前發生規模7.1強震，造成當地建築、道路及交通設施受損，災後救援與重建工作持續進行。中華航空宣布，華航集團將捐出新台幣1,000萬元，支援熊本地區災後救援及重建工作。
除提供現金援助外，華航也將投入航空運輸資源，即日起至8月底前，協助政府機關、公益團體、宗教團體及相關救援組織免費載運賑災物資前往災區，讓急需物資能透過航空運能加速送抵當地。
華航表示，熊本為華航集團飛航航點之一，集團以企業社會責任及人道關懷為出發點，盼藉由捐款與運輸支援，將台灣社會的關懷送往受災地區，協助居民早日重建家園。
熊本縣熊本地方於7月28日下午發生地震，規模為7.1，宇城市及冰川町觀測到最大震度7；日本政府一度針對有明海及八代海發布海嘯注意報。災區後續仍須面對建物受損、道路與橋梁受阻，以及交通與公共設施修復等挑戰。

en.title: China Airlines Group donates NT$10 million and offers free relief cargo transport after Kumamoto earthquake
en.summary: A recent magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Japan’s Kumamoto Prefecture damaged buildings, roads and transport infrastructure. As rescue and reconstruction efforts continue, China Airlines announced that its group will donate NT$10 million to support recovery in the affected area.
body: A recent magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Japan’s Kumamoto Prefecture damaged buildings, roads and transport infrastructure. As rescue and reconstruction efforts continue, China Airlines announced that its group will donate NT$10 million to support recovery in the affected area.

In addition to financial assistance, China Airlines will provide air transport resources. From now until the end of August, it will carry relief supplies to the disaster area free of charge for government agencies, charities, religious groups and other relief organizations, helping urgently needed supplies reach local communities more quickly.

China Airlines said Kumamoto is one of the destinations served by the group. Guided by corporate social responsibility and humanitarian concern, it hopes its donations and transport support will convey the care of people in Taiwan and help affected residents rebuild their homes.

An earthquake struck the Kumamoto area of Kumamoto Prefecture on the afternoon of July 28, with a magnitude of 7.1. Uki City and Hikawa Town recorded a maximum seismic intensity of 7, and the Japanese government temporarily issued tsunami advisories for the Ariake Sea and Yatsushiro Sea. The affected area continues to face challenges including damaged buildings, blocked roads and bridges, and repairs to transport infrastructure and public facilities.
